name: The Punisher
description:
Pick a loadout. Load the guns. Make them stay down.
Frank Castle walks into every fight with a plan: choose one of five Loadouts at setup, from the Warzone arsenal to the War Machine Armor, and build the game around it. All-purpose counters feed his weapons, and 'Til They Stay Down readies them again. Haunted by his past and hunted by Jigsaw, he is the most tactical gunfight in the game. Includes an Aggression starter deck. 27 cards. English and Spanish. Pairs with Fear No Evil.
